function: The align-items property specifies the default alignment for items inside a flexbox or grid container.

values.function: Default. Behaves like 'stretch' for flexbox and grid items, or 'start' for grid items with a defined block size.
Items are stretched to fit the container
Items are positioned at the center of the container
Items are positioned at the beginning of the container
Items are positioned at the end of the container
Items are positioned at the beginning of their individual grid cells, in the block direction
Items are positioned at the end of the their individual grid cells, in the block direction
Items are positioned at the baseline of the container
